assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Create one opaque landscape atlas of six different first-grade science illustrations. Exactly 2 equal rows and 3 equal columns of square cells in a 3:2 image, six occupied cells. Each scene stays entirely inside its own cell with at least 9% quiet margin on each side. Cell boundaries are invisible, no line or art crossing any border. Use a warm ivory matte gouache paper background, simple recognizable silhouettes, fine paper grain, natural colors, apricot and pine accents. For mini stories inside cells, two softly separated subpanels are intentional. Clear shape separation and very simple backgrounds so each cell is readable after reduction to 96 pixels. No text, letters, numbers, logos, checkmarks, arrows or watermark.
Row 1, column 1. One whole living crucian carp (Carassius carassius), exact broadside head left and tail right, in a pale-teal rectangular area of clear water. Silver-olive oval body, one near eye, small curved gill-cover seam immediately behind head, clear scale pattern, naturally placed fins, one subtly forked caudal fin. No barbels. Full head, body and tail separated for precise overlay circles.
Row 1, column 2. Two clearly separate horizontal bands within the square. Upper: full hornless white domestic goat standing left-facing, realistic short tail, muzzle and four cloven-hooved legs. Lower: full gray-white domestic goose standing left-facing, two natural orange webbed feet both on flat ground, distinct bill and tail. No grass or shadows obscuring feet. Full animals and extra margin for later annotation.
Row 1, column 3. One whole cream-wool domestic sheep alone on blank cream ground, in exact left-facing side view. Natural soft wool, sheep muzzle, small ochre patch at base of visible ear, four cloven-hooved legs (natural far-side overlap), distinct small downturned natural tail at right rump. All feet, muzzle and tail visible with safe margins. No horns or extras.
Row 2, column 1. One simple square courtyard scene. Gray-white domestic goose behind a waist-high light pine slatted fence. One child in sage top and apricot trousers is very near the outside of fence, one arm extending toward the goose above the fence, hand still clearly separated from animal. No adult, no food or contact. Child and goose fully visible, hand gesture obvious.
Row 2, column 2. Exactly the same gray-white domestic goose, fence, sage-shirt child and quiet courtyard. Goose remains behind fence. Child stands clearly back from fence, both hands down, and one calm adult stands beside child. All calmly look at the goose, no food or contact. Show a clear gap between child and fence.
Row 2, column 3. Exactly the same gray-white goose and sage-shirt child, in the same simple courtyard. Child runs behind the goose with a generous gap as goose moves away to the left. Full bodies and clear running poses, no touching, injury, feed or grabbing. Low pine fence is in the background.
